description: A KS256 COSE_Sign1 signature and its high-s twin over one Sig_structure, with the expected verdicts. Every verifier that recovers a KS256 signer must accept s <= (n-1)/2 and reject s > (n-1)/2, n the secp256k1 group order (spec/checkpoints-and-receipts.md). A second pair straddles the bound itself.
generator: cast wallet sign --no-hash (Foundry 1.5.1, RFC 6979) signs digest_hex with test_key for accept/low-s; each other case is derived from it as its note says. Deterministic: rerunning gives these bytes.

conventions.signature: 65 bytes r || s || v, big-endian r and s, v the recovery id 0 or 1
conventions.digest: keccak256(Sig_structure); Sig_structure is ["Signature1", protected, h'', payload]
conventions.cose_sign1: untagged, empty unprotected header, attached payload
conventions.test_key: private_key_d_hex is keccak256 of the label, reduced mod n; a test scalar, never a deployed key

cases.name: accept/low-s
cases.note: the test key's RFC 6979 signature; s is below (n-1)/2

cases.name: reject/high-s
cases.note: (r, n-s, v^1): the malleated twin of accept/low-s; it recovers the same address, so only the s bound rejects it

cases.name: accept/s-at-bound
cases.note: s = (n-1)/2, the largest s accepted; r and v are accept/low-s's, and the signer is the address this recovers to

cases.name: reject/s-above-bound
cases.note: s = (n+1)/2, the smallest s rejected: the twin of accept/s-at-bound
